title: Amazon S3 to AWS Lambda to Amazon DynamoDB
description: Upload object data from S3 to DynamoDB via Lambda.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern in CDK offers a complete solution to load data from CSV files stored on S3. The following resources are created:
- S3 Bucket with event notification on object creates
- DynamoDB Table with on-demand billing mode
- Lambda function that runs python and takes environment variables of bucket name, object key, and dynamodb table
